messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it"
set: ["tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it", "tell your eye surgeon you take or have taken it", "tell surgeon and dentist about use", "mention it if you take digoxin", "tell your surgeon before any operation", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "tell any doctor or dentist treating you that you take spironolactone", "clean it and let it dry", "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "caregiver must know where you keep it and how to use it", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "know all medicines you take", "take it as soon as you remember if you miss a dose of the oral suspension", "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to", "it may take 4 weeks or longer before you feel the full benefit"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "tell your eye surgeon you take or have taken it",
    "tell surgeon and dentist about use",
    "tell your surgeon before any operation",
    "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol",
    "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery",
    "tell any doctor or dentist treating you that you take spironolactone",
    "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication",
    "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to"
  ],
  "alias": "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it"
}
